name: sante-life-science-kit-desk
description: Server-side API routes (Vercel serverless functions) for Sante Life Science Kit Desk. The app itself is the static index.html at the repo root — this package.json exists only so Vercel installs the dependencies these /api functions need. Uses ES modules ("type": "module") because firebase-admin's auth module pulls in an ESM-only dependency (jose) that crashes under plain CommonJS require() on Vercel's Node runtime.
